beats.headline: Three common cards
beats.text: When the fight is done, Carl and Donut have collected three common utility cards. Two are Time Extend cards, which double how long a summoned totem lasts, and the third is a Stout card, which adds 25% to a mob's health for the duration of combat. Unlike their combo card, these are not one-time consumables. Team Sister Ines gets three cards too. Nobody is sure yet how deck combat works.

beats.headline: Spinning like a ninja star
beats.text: Geraldo the monk seal is summoned, the enemy is on its way, and Donut tries the utility cards on him. She puts her paw on the Stout card and flips it upward. It spins through the air like a ninja star and slams into the seal with a loud trumpet fanfare, and Geraldo glows as his health bar grows longer. The word Buffed appears over him in a comic-book explosion. This is quite festive, Donut says; why can't all the fights be like this?

beats.headline: A second one from Katia
beats.text: Katia comes over to check on Carl and offers utility cards. Her team has little trolls everywhere, called the Lads, that drop a lot of cards, and Louis has mass killed about two hundred of them with a cloud attack. She plops a deck onto the counter, full of Time Extend and Buff cards and others Carl has not seen, and pushes over a pair of consumable Flee cards. Carl grabs another Stout card and two new utility cards, Blue Stuff and Greased Lightning.

beats.headline: Into the practice deck
beats.text: Carl and Donut build an eighteen-card deck, and one of its six utility cards is a single Stout, which Carl lists as strength-increasing. In the practice room's 1980s shopping mall, Donut's first four cards are Greased Lightning, Stout, Shi Maria and Uzi Jesus. Carl tells her to save the utility cards and play the two totems: summon Jesus, talk to him for a second, then summon Shi Maria. He wants to see how the two work together.

beats.headline: Onto the stolen warrior
beats.text: Donut's active deck for the turkey barn holds two Stout cards. Late in the fight, with zombie turkeys rising, she is distracted, slicing at one that moves to chomp onto the unconscious Mongo. She tosses a new card, but it is a Stout, and she tosses it onto her stolen lizard temple warrior, who keeps screaming about his mother. Then Carl runs at the turkey deckmaster, and his kick obliterates it.

relations.note: the second Stout card, from her team's spares
